title: Repair a Reordering Editor
prompt: Build a reorderable note editor with per-row draft state and a jump-to-top threshold, demonstrating stable keys and narrow observation.
successCriteria: Drafts follow note IDs after sorting.
Threshold state avoids per-pixel composition changes.
Inspection explains the scopes that update.
hints: Begin with immutable state and a stateless content composable.
Verify one lifecycle, configuration, or rapid-interaction edge case before polishing visuals.
solutionOutline: Define the state, events, ownership boundary, and UI contract.
Implement the smallest correct flow, then exercise every success criterion.
verification: Run focused state and interaction tests.
Inspect semantics and the relevant lifecycle or runtime behaviour.
